meta.title: For Managers — NestSelf
meta.description: Resources and guidance for managers: team polls, conversation guides and how to point someone to support — without overstepping.

hero.title: Support your team without overstepping
hero.lead: NestSelf gives you practical tools and guidance for the moments when a team member might need support. You do not need to be a therapist — just a thoughtful manager.

features.title: What you get as a manager

items.title: Team wellbeing polls
items.body: Run short, anonymous polls to understand how your team is doing — without putting anyone on the spot.

items.title: Conversation guides
items.body: Step-by-step guides for sensitive conversations: how to ask, what to say and what not to say.

items.title: When and how to point someone to support
items.body: Clear guidance on recognising signs and making a referral to NestSelf — without diagnosing or pressuring.

items.title: Manager resources
items.body: Curated articles, webinars and tools for managers navigating team wellbeing.

steps.title: Notice
steps.body: Pay attention to changes in behaviour, energy or engagement. You do not need to diagnose — just notice.

steps.title: Ask privately
steps.body: Find a quiet moment. Ask how they are doing. Keep it simple and genuine.

steps.title: Listen without diagnosing
steps.body: Let them talk. You do not need to fix anything. Listening is the most important step.

steps.title: Point to NestSelf
steps.body: Let them know that NestSelf is available and confidential. Share the link or mention it naturally.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Check in again after a few days. You do not need to ask about details — just show you care.
